text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Show revenue by store location over time (by month) so the decline can be seen per location; the project has no 'region' dimension, and 'why' and 'which to invest in' are judgments the data alone cannot answer.","measures":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","aggregation":"sum","alias":"revenue"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.location_id","role":"key"},{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","role":"time","grain":"month"}],"display":["column:dev.locations.location_name"],"filters":[],"ordering":{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","direction":"asc"},"expectedShape":"trend","unresolved":[{"clause":"by region","options":["column:dev.orders.location_id"],"material":true,"question":"This project has no region; store location is the closest grouping — should revenue be broken down by location, or do you have a region mapping elsewhere?"},{"clause":"revenue","options":["column:dev.orders.subtotal","column:dev.orders.order_total"],"material":true,"question":"Should revenue be the pretax order subtotal or the order total including tax?"},{"clause":"why is revenue down, and which region should we invest in","options":[],"material":true,"question":"The warehouse can show the revenue trend per location, but the cause of a decline and an investment recommendation are not held in the data — which time window should the trend compare?"}],"provenance":{"column:dev.orders.subtotal":"q:revenue","column:dev.orders.location_id":"q:by region","column:dev.locations.location_name":"q:by region","column:dev.orders.ordered_at":"q:down"}}
